title: OTF (Open Tab Format)
description: OTF is the Bluegrass Songbook's tab format: one JSON document per tab, usually stored as *.otf.json. VERSION RULE. otf_version is "MAJOR.MINOR"; "1.0" is the shape as of G15a (2026-10-28). Adding an OPTIONAL field bumps the minor version. Anything else (a rename, a removal, a change of meaning, a new required field) bumps the major version. Files of any earlier 1.x stay valid under the current schema. Writers stamp the current version; readers accept any 1.x and reject any other major. The order of properties in this file is the canonical key order used when a document is written out (G15b). Keys starting with an underscore are runtime view caches and are never valid in a file. Some rules JSON Schema cannot express are enforced by both validators (scripts/lib/otf_schema.py and validateOTF in docs/js/otf-editor/actions.js); they are listed in docs/schema/otf.md.

otf_version.description: Format version, "MAJOR.MINOR". Any "1.x" is accepted; see the version rule in this schema's description.

metadata.description: What the tab is: title, time signature, tempo, and optional credits.

time_signature.description: Default time signature for every measure, as "beats/unit" ("4/4", "6/8"). Measures listed in time_signature_changes override it for that measure only.

tempo.description: Tempo in quarter-note beats per minute.

key.description: Key of the tune, as written by the source ("G", "Am"). May be empty.

composer.description: Composer or arranger credit. May be empty.

time_signature_changes.description: Per-measure time signature overrides. Each entry applies ONLY to its own measure; every other measure follows metadata.time_signature.

measure.description: 1-based measure number the override applies to.

timing.description: The tick grid every tick and duration in the document is measured on.

ticks_per_beat.description: Ticks in one beat, where a beat is a quarter note (480 in every file so far). A measure of n/d is n*4/d beats long.

tracks.description: The instruments in the tab. Each has a matching key in notation.

id.description: Track id, unique in the document. It is the key of this track's notation.

instrument.description: Instrument name as the source gave it ("5-string-banjo", "mandolin", "percussion", ...). Free text.

tuning.description: Open-string pitches, string 1 first ("D4"). Its length is the track's string count. Empty only on a percussion track, which counts lines instead.

role.description: What the track does in the arrangement.

percussion.description: True on a percussion track. Requires lines.

lines.description: Number of staff lines (instruments) on a percussion track; its notes' s counts against this instead of the tuning length.

notation.description: The music: one key per track id, each a list of measures.

measure.description: 1-based measure number. Unique and ascending within a track.

events.description: Moments in the measure that have notes, ascending by tick.

tick.description: Offset from the start of the measure, in ticks. Unique and ascending within a measure, and inside the measure's length.

notes.description: Notes struck at this tick, at most one per string.

annotations.description: Text marks above the staff (chord names, section labels, remarks).

tick.description: Offset inside that measure, in ticks.

reading_list.description: Playback order: measure ranges to play, in order (repeats and jumps unrolled). Absent means play straight through.

from_measure.description: First measure of the range, inclusive.

to_measure.description: Last measure of the range, inclusive. A range running past the last written measure is a warning, not an error (#263).

x_source.description: Provenance of the tab (type, source_id, author, url, converted_at, ...). Free-form: the only object in the format that accepts unknown keys.

note.description: One note: a string and a fret, plus optional articulation. Property order here is the canonical key order for a note.

s.description: String number, 1 = the first tuning entry. Must not exceed the track's string count (or lines, for percussion).

tie.description: True when this note is tied to the previous note on the same string.

tech.description: Left-hand technique into this note: h hammer-on, p pull-off, / slide up, \ slide down, x dead (muted) note, b bend.

fx.description: Per-note effects, a set stored in this canonical order. Omitted when empty.

grace.description: A grace note leading into this note. It has no tick of its own.

f.description: Fret of the grace note, 0 = open.

kind.description: How the grace note connects to the main note. Absent means a plain grace note.

finger.description: Picking-hand finger: T thumb, I index, M middle, R ring, P pinky.

lh.description: Left-hand finger: 0 open, 1 index, 2 middle, 3 ring, 4 pinky.
